title: Plan
intro: Work streams, their programs and projects, each with an owner. Everyone can read the plan; owners edit what they own and everything below it, and administrators edit everything.
emptyHint: An administrator creates the first work stream.
emptyHintCreate: Create the first work stream to start planning.
ownerHint: Owners edit this and everything below it, and can hand it over to someone else.
saveForbidden: You are not allowed to change this
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid — check the owner and the dates
saveGone: This no longer exists — reload the page

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must not be before the start
validation.windowBoth: Set both target dates or neither

workStream.endDateHint: Set only when the work stream is closed. Clear it to reopen.
workStream.saveConflict: A work stream with this name already exists
workStream.deleteConflict: This work stream still has programs. Delete them first.

program.saveConflict: A program with this name already exists
program.deleteConflict: This program still has projects. Delete them first.

project.fieldsReadOnly: Only the project's owner, an owner above it or an administrator can change these fields.
project.windowReadOnly: Only an administrator, an owner above the project or a roadmap editor can change the target window.
project.saveConflict: A project with this name already exists in this program
project.deleteConflict: This project cannot be deleted right now.
